source: Successful actual 8x8 fixedscale64 pilot; numerical implementation reused byte-for-byte
scope: 100 complete train-only SVHN epochs; fresh initialization; same numerical route as the completed8x8pilot
numerical_change: None versus the completed8x8pilot. Only endpoint and reporting expand to100.
quantization_source: one current E4M3 encoding per MX layer and minibatch, shared across all three modes
exponent_mapping: s e3 e2 e1 e0 m2 m1 m0 -> s e3 e2 m2 m1 m0; target bias1; no bias compensation
mantissa_mapping: derived E2M3 uint8 codes >> 2; unchanged E2M3 scale equals original E4M3 scale times64
loss: E4M3 hard CE + E2M3 soft CE from detached E4M3 + E2M1 soft CE from detached E2M3; T=1; gradients summed, no division by 3
ste_policy: identity wrt G(W) for E4M3 and complete scale64 E4-to-E2 code path; no extra factor64 in backward; retain original G(W) derivatives; no gradient through codes or scales
shared_scale_policy: encode current E4M3 source scale floor(log2(amax))-8; clip[-127,127], zero block exponent0; both lower scale codes equal source code+6; integer promoted before addition; overflow above254 rejected without clipping/wrap, including zero blocks; source scales can change after optimizer steps
source_cache_policy: detached integer source and derived codes; one triplet per minibatch; cleared before Adam
selection: first strict maximum of E4M3/A32 official-test top1
reporting: all three modes from same selected E4M3-best checkpoint and epoch100; incomplete runs also retain last completed epoch
research_outcome_policy: low accuracy, constant predictions or zero finite gradients/updates are diagnostics, not automatic FAIL
expected_initial_model_sha256_scope: Historical laptop/runtime expectation; independently verify initialization equality in same runtime. CPU digest may differ.

purpose.before: five complete train-only epochs: 8x8 square groups of64, fixed scale64 route, E4M3 source, naive exponent truncation plus fixed scale64 to E2M3, then mantissa truncation to E2M1
purpose.after: 100 complete train-only epochs: 8x8 square groups of64, fixed scale64 route, E4M3 source, naive exponent truncation plus fixed scale64 to E2M3, then mantissa truncation to E2M1

reporting_policy.before: all three modes from same selected E4M3-best checkpoint; also all at last pilot epoch
reporting_policy.after: all three modes from same selected E4M3-best checkpoint and epoch100; incomplete runs also retain last completed epoch
